name: ai.sidetrip.connect/hackernews
title: Sidetrip Hacker News
description: Hacker News front page, search, threads and users. Demo by Sidetrip Connect. No API key.

tools.name: top_stories
tools.description: Read the Hacker News front page from the official Firebase API. feed is top (default), new, or best. Returns at most 15 stories (default 8) with id, title, author, score, time, url, and comment count.

feed.description: Which front page to read. Defaults to top.

limit.description: How many stories to return. Default 8, maximum 15.

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Search Hacker News with the keyless Algolia API. kind is story (default), comment, show_hn, ask_hn, or poll. Returns at most 15 hits (default 8).

limit.description: How many hits to return. Default 8, maximum 15.

tools.name: get_item_with_comments
tools.description: Fetch one Hacker News item and a short comment tree from the official Firebase API. depth is 0 to 2 (default 2). Each level keeps at most 4 comments (default 3). Text is plain and truncated.

depth.description: Comment depth. 0 returns the item only. Default 2, maximum 2.

replies.description: Comments kept at each level. Default 3, maximum 4.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Read a Hacker News profile from the official Firebase API, plus at most 5 recent submissions. The about text is plain and truncated.

id.description: Hacker News username, such as pg.

tools.name: show_or_ask_hn
tools.description: Read the current Show HN or Ask HN list from the official Firebase API. kind is show or ask. Returns at most 15 stories (default 8).

kind.description: show reads Show HN. ask reads Ask HN.

limit.description: How many stories to return. Default 8, maximum 15.
